_comment: Extra files for add-ons, downloaded on demand (kioku/packs.py). Any add-on whose code imports 'modules' or 'imports', or names one of 'programs', is offered the pack; 'own_files' in an add-on mean it brings its own. 'site': paths in site-packages that move from the app into the pack; 'drop': files left out of the pack. size/unpacked/sha256 are written by shared/tools/packs.py build. Change 'version' for new files (the file name follows it).

packs.title: Chinese word segmentation (jieba)
packs.description: Splits Chinese text into words. Used by Chinese add-ons such as word frequency and dictionary tools.

packs.title: Code highlighting (Pygments)
packs.description: Colors source code. Used by add-ons that highlight code on cards.

packs.title: Text recognition languages (Tesseract)
packs.description: English, Japanese, Chinese and Korean models for OCR add-ons that read text from images.

packs.title: Speech voices (eSpeak NG)
packs.description: Voices and dictionaries for text-to-speech add-ons that use eSpeak.
